principle: one secured platform; independently authorized and independently sleeping runtime modules

modules.name: Customer App
modules.sleep_rule: public SEO pages do not load customer-app datasets

modules.name: Detailer Mobile App
modules.wake_rule: bounded workspace after sign-in; live bundle only for Arrived/Detailing/Paused assigned work
modules.sleep_rule: no eligible open job = no live bundle, live feed, media or recurring messaging activity

modules.name: Operations / Supervisor App
modules.sleep_rule: opening the shell loads no operations dataset and no polling

modules.name: Business Administration App
modules.sleep_rule: opening the shell loads no back-office dataset

modules.name: I.T. & Reliability App
modules.wake_rule: owner explicitly opens a preflight/test/diagnostic/recovery workflow
modules.sleep_rule: no background tests, health scans or preflights merely because I.T. is available

modules.name: Finance App
modules.sleep_rule: no finance datasets load from launcher or shell

modules.name: DAIP App
modules.wake_rule: owner explicitly opens a DAIP workflow and existing DAIP gates permit the action
modules.sleep_rule: no DAIP media/processing/AI/public destination wakes from shell load

modules.name: Socials & Integrations App
modules.sleep_rule: no external social/provider/API call occurs merely from shell load

native_strategy.mobile: PWA now; Capacitor-native wrapper is the next packaging layer for app-store/native push
native_strategy.desktop: installed PWA now; Tauri wrapper is the next layer only if true system-tray/background-native behavior is required
